# baffinbay_custom_page (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay Custom Page by UUID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_custom_page" "waf_block" {
  name = "blocked.html"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The custom page UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive custom page name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The HTML content downloaded from the custom page file endpoint.
- `created_at` (String)
- `type` (String)
